en: Ah, and the fool who freed me shall be among the first to quell my immense hunger.
%s is dazed...
Can you tell me about this shard?

The Alliance has completed its gathering tasks, $c. Now, while we pack and prepare everything, we await the Horde's collections to be completed. Then we shall all transport our war materiel to Silithus.

Amazing, aren't they? All these artifacts and remains.$B$BI'm not sure what I'm more impressed by, their size, or the stories that go along with them. There's so much to study and learn. And the connections we can make...$B$BDid you know rumor has it that many races have the same heritage as Night elves?
What, you can't port there?  Go to the Darkbriar Lodge next to the lake in the Valley of Spirits, up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

Renataki, of the Thousand Blades.$B$BPain is his lifeblood.  Fear, his ally.  May he one day return and bring joyous bloodshed with him.  $B$BRenataki now dwells far from here.  One day, he may return...
We have some supplies, but not many.  We'll need a lot more in order to send a ground assault into the Field of Strife.
I'll get to work right away, $n!
Your name will be remembered down through the ages, $n.  Seek out Taim Ragetotem on the Hunter Rise and he will assist you on your way to Alterac Valley.
You have certainly come a long way in your training. There is only one instructor who can train you further. Find Buzzek Bracketswing in Gadgetzan!
For the Alliance!
There is a symmetry in the idea of the hide of your enemy providing you with protection.  To further your leatherworking skills look for Una inside the Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.
You have my word that I shall find a use for your body after I've killed you, $r.
Curse? What's going on here, Fairbanks?
I summon you, Sha'ni Proudtusk!
Greetings.  I'm a warlock trainer, but you're not a warlock!
There is bound to be a gnome in Stormwind that can teach you the profession.  I'm sure one of the Stormwind Guards could point you in the right direction.
I'd train you if I could, but you're too much for me. Tell you what: go talk to the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. She's got some real talent.
Oh, you mean Johnson?  I heard he's in hiding.
The fleet is ready, $n. You must take this beacon and place it at the eastern crater of the central battlezone. Defend the beacon from attackers until the fleet is able to lock on to its coordinates!
What am I going to do?
The only thing Metzen is going to be doing this Winter Veil is roasting on a spit!
The Irondeep Mine is in Alliance territory, north of the Stormpike Graveyard.$B$BIt is controlled by the Troggs.
Ooh, it's a nice one! Let me just dig it up...
I do not offer apprentice training. Look for the tauren Waldor in the Wailing Caverns, here in the Barrens. He can assist you with whatever you need.
Hey Hornizz!  I'm back!  And there are some people behind me who helped me out of a jam.
Not looking too good today. Sun is high and bright early and no activity on the water.

Welcome back to the greatest show on Azeroth, my friend!  It is truly a delight to see you once again.$B$BPlease, step right up and once more take in all we have to offer.  Be sure to check around, as we are always adding new and exciting things to the Darkmoon Faire!  Amaze at wonders old and new that we have uncovered!  We continue to spare no expense in bringing you excitement that children of all ages will delight in!
%s hears her owner's voice!
Eh?  You have business with Nimboya?
The Warchief shall make quick work of you, mortals. Prepare yourselves!
Bear witness to the undeniable power of your Warchief! Be lifted by the rallying cry of your dragon slayers!
Desolace is not such a bad place, if you don't mind the constant harassments from the centaurs.
%s goes into a rage!
Maybe we should go to the bridge and fish.

Stop - no. Slow down - maybe.$B$BThe Scholomance is their primary source of training and education. It is from there that the Cult members fan out and ultimately, make their way into our societies.$B$BThat is why we must strike at the source. The very heart of the Cult of the Damned!

Why is this happening? Put simply, the spirits of the wind just... vanished. 

The petty sprites and lesser elementals you've likely encountered out there are a pale imitation of the true spirits of wind. Non-sentient, aimless, and a far cry from the kindly spirits we lived in harmony alongside for thousands of years.
Your skills are beyond my reach. It is time for you to face new challenges. Taladan will help you prepare. He is standing by the table there.
If you are seeking a truly rewarding pursuit, then a life of enchanting is for you!
Tell the Warden this prison is ours now!
While Cyndra is not bubbly like her potions, her kind manner is suitable for teaching her trade.  You can find her just east of the Inn in Dolanaar.
Master craftsman Omarion just vanished one night. Like a toot in the wind... Poof! Gone! Bah, now I'm the only one left to craft the goods for the boys on the front lines.
None can stand against the Serpent Lords!
Outstandin' fightin'! Ya made an old man proud. Keep it up and ale will be on me ta'night.
$n claims the mine!  If left unchallenged, the Alliance will control it in 1 minute!
Your petty magics are no challenge to the might of the Scourge!
He he!  This will be a great hiding spot.
